q.zh: 你是做什么的？

a.zh: 我做 AI 产品功能，从定问题、搭 Agent 到出题评测，整条线自己走完。交出来的不只是功能，还有它好用的证据。
a.en: I build AI product features end to end: framing the problem, building the agent, writing the tests. What I hand over is the feature and the evidence that it works.

q.zh: 你在找什么工作？

a.zh: 在找 AI 产品、评测、运营方向的实习，随时可以到岗。
a.en: An internship in AI product, evaluation or operations. I can start right away.

q.zh: 你的背景？

a.zh: 莫纳什大学马来西亚校区，计算机科学本科在读。学的是计算机，做的是 AI 产品：带出处的问答、审核和标注 Agent、Agent 评测。
a.en: Computer science undergraduate at Monash University Malaysia. I study computing and build AI products: question answering with sources, review and labelling agents, agent evaluation.

q.zh: 你最拿手的是什么？

a.zh: 给 AI 功能出题、定标准，再照着结果把它改到位。搭 Agent 和工作流、写 Skill 和 MCP 工具、用 SQL 做分析，也是我常做的事。
a.en: Writing the test set and the scoring rules for an AI feature, then improving it against the results. Building agents and workflows, writing Skills and MCP tools and analysing data in SQL are everyday work too.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 先看哪个项目？
q.en: Which project should I look at first?

a.zh: 从 Agent 评测台开始：会调工具的 Agent，每一步做得对不对，它都量得出来。接着看有据审核和标注 Agent 工具箱，一个做广告审核，一个做内容标注。
a.en: Start with Agent Trace Eval: it measures whether a tool-using agent gets each step right. Then Grounded Review and the Labelling Agent Kit, one for ad review, one for content labelling.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 用过哪些工具？

a.zh: 评测用 promptfoo、agentevals、Inspect AI；搭 Agent 用 Claude 接口、Agent Skill、MCP、Dify 和 Lark 工作流；数据用 Python、SQL、Pandas。
a.en: Evaluation: promptfoo, agentevals, Inspect AI. Agents: the Claude API, Agent Skills, MCP, Dify and Lark workflows. Data: Python, SQL, Pandas.

q.zh: 怎么联系你？

a.zh: GitHub：llia0031-dotcom。简历上有我的邮箱，随时找我聊。
a.en: GitHub: llia0031-dotcom. My email is on my résumé; get in touch any time.

q.zh: 哪些项目能直接打开试？
q.en: Which projects can I try in the browser?

a.zh: 最快的是有据审核的演示页，打开就能看。Cairn、简历初筛、卖点体检、AI 生图创作指南和标注 Agent 工具箱也都有能点开的页面。
a.en: The quickest is the Grounded Review demo page: open it and look. Cairn, resume screening, Sellpoint Check, Text on Product and the Labelling Agent Kit all have pages you can open too.

q.zh: 代码在哪？

a.zh: 都在 GitHub 上公开，用 MIT 许可证。大多数项目带离线命令，不用密钥就能重算全部结果。
a.en: All public on GitHub under the MIT licence. Most come with an offline command that recomputes every result without a key.

q.zh: 这些项目是一个人做的吗？
q.en: Did you build these on your own?

a.zh: Cairn 和 TraceDesk Lite 是黑客松上两人组队做的，其余都是我独立完成的。
a.en: Cairn and TraceDesk Lite were built by a team of two at hackathons; the rest I built on my own.

q.zh: 用的什么模型？

a.zh: 默认用省钱的 claude-haiku-5-5，大批评测走批量接口。要对照时再换别的，比如本机跑的 Qwen 小模型。
a.en: claude-haiku-5-5 by default, which keeps costs low, with big evaluation runs through the batch API. Other models come in for comparison, like small Qwen models run locally.

q.zh: 评测是怎么做的？

a.zh: 先把题目和答案定好、冻结，再跑；每改一版都在同一套题上重测，过了事先定的标准才采用。
a.en: Items and answers are fixed and frozen first; every version is re-run on the same items and adopted once it clears the bar set beforehand.

q.zh: 做得最好的结果是什么？

a.zh: 标注 Agent 先读规则、再看相似案例，广告的 F1 从 0.768 升到 0.971。有据可查让编数字的回答从 4/32 降到 0/32。
a.en: Reading the rules first and similar cases after took the labelling agent's ad F1 from 0.768 to 0.971. evidence-check took answers with an invented number from 4/32 to 0/32.

label.zh: 评测卡：标注 Agent 工具箱

q.zh: 项目有英文版吗？
q.en: Are the projects available in English?

a.zh: 有。项目页和评测卡都有中英文两版，代码仓库都有英文说明，评测报告也是英文的。
a.en: Yes. Project pages and evaluation cards come in Chinese and English, every repository has an English README, and the evaluation reports are in English.

q.zh: 这些项目对应哪些业务场景？
q.en: Which business scenarios do the projects cover?

a.zh: 广告审核、内容标注、电商、经营分析、创作工具、语音、招聘初筛，还有按资料带出处地回答问题，每个都照业务里真会用的方式来做。
a.en: Ad review, content labelling, e-commerce, business review, creator tools, voice, resume screening, and answering from documents with sources, each built the way the business would use it.

q.zh: 有广告审核方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看有据审核：它说得出违反哪一条、是哪几个字。审视频广告的话，再看审核模型实验。
a.en: Look at Grounded Review: it names the rule and the exact words. For video ads, Policy Model Lab.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 有内容标注方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看标注 Agent 工具箱：换一套规则就能接新任务，错在哪、为什么错都有表。跑成每天的流程，看有据标注流水线。
a.en: Look at the Labelling Agent Kit: a new folder of rules takes on a new task, with a table of where and why it fails. For running it every day, the Grounded Labelling Pipeline.

q.zh: 有电商方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看卖点体检：卖点要在买家评价里找到原话才算数。做商品图的话，再看 AI 生图创作指南。
a.en: Look at Sellpoint Check: a claim counts only when buyer reviews back it word for word. For product images, Text on Product.

label.zh: AI 生图创作指南：电商主图上的中文字
label.en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

q.zh: 有经营分析方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看有据经营分析：Agent 自己查数找原因，周报里每个数字都对得回查询结果。
a.en: Look at Grounded Business Review: the agent queries for the cause itself, and every number in the weekly review traces back to a query.

q.zh: 有创作工具方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看创作者 Skill 合集：字幕、分镜、热点三件事，交出去前都先用脚本查一遍。
a.en: Look at Creator skills: subtitles, shot lists and trend topics, each checked by a script before it goes back.

label.zh: AI 生图创作指南：电商主图上的中文字
label.en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

q.zh: 有语音方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看实时语音 Agent 体验评测：打断、附和、背景人声，一项一项测过，再把有用的改进合在一起。
a.en: Look at the real-time voice agent study: interruptions, backchannels and background speech, tested one at a time, then the useful fixes combined.

label.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测

q.zh: 有招聘方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看简历初筛：每个“符合”都要附简历原文，只换名字也不改变去留。
a.en: Look at resume screening: every "met" has to quote the resume, and swapping the name alone doesn't change the decision.

q.zh: 有 Agent 评测方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看 Agent 评测台：按步骤评，看得出失败从哪一步开始。
a.en: Look at Agent Trace Eval: it scores each step, so you can see where a failure starts.

label.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测

q.zh: 有模型评测方向的项目吗？

a.zh: 看模型裁判校准：测的是模型当裁判能信到哪一步，哪些判断该交给人。
a.en: Look at Judge Calibration: how far a model judge can be trusted, and which calls belong with people.

q.zh: 有带出处的问答方向的项目吗？
q.en: Anything on question answering with sources?

a.zh: 看有据可查：装上就能用，AI 写的每个数字都要对得上原文。完整的问答产品，看 Cairn 和 TraceDesk Lite。
a.en: Look at evidence-check: install it and every number an AI writes has to match its source. For full Q&A products, Cairn and TraceDesk Lite.

q.zh: 有据可查 evidence-check 是什么？

a.zh: 一个 Agent Skill 加一个核对脚本：AI 写的每个数字和原话，都得在给它的资料里找得到。装上这个 Skill 后，AI 按资料回答时，编了数字的回答从 4/32 降到 0/32。
a.en: An Agent Skill plus a checker: every number and quote an AI writes has to be found in the material it was given. With the skill, answers that made up a number fell from 4/32 to 0/32.

q.zh: Cairn 是什么？

a.zh: 黑客松上两人做的问答台，按机构公开的规定回答，每句话都逐字引原文。正确页面排进前五条结果的：自己写的题 44/45，学生的真实提问 14/15。
a.en: A Q&A desk built by two at a hackathon: it answers from an organisation's published rules and quotes them word for word. The right page made the top five results for 44/45 written questions and 14/15 real student questions.

q.zh: TraceDesk Lite 是什么？

a.zh: 黑客松上两人做的常见问题助手，只按给定资料回答，截止时间放最前、附出处。每个截止时间都附原文出处的回答有 20/20，普通写法只有 17/20。
a.en: An FAQ assistant built by two at a hackathon: it answers only from the given documents, deadlines first, each with its source. Answers whose every deadline came with its source: 20/20, against 17/20 with a plain prompt.

q.zh: 有据可查的简历初筛是什么？

a.zh: 初筛简历时，让模型给每个“符合”都附上简历原文，再用脚本核对。附上简历原文后，判断几乎不出错（2735/2736），只换名字也不改变去留（0/240）。
a.en: Resume screening where the model backs every "met" with a quote from the resume, checked by script. With resume quotes, verdicts were right 2735/2736 times; swapping names changed 0/240 decisions.

q.zh: 卖点体检是什么？

a.zh: 把商品页的卖点拿到买家评价里找原话，证实了才给买家看，其余私下交给商家。用买家评价核对卖点：答案已知的卖点判对 60/60，花费只有逐条读评价的 17%。
a.en: It takes a listing's claims to the buyer reviews for supporting quotes; buyers see only confirmed claims, the rest goes privately to the merchant. Claims checked against reviews: 60/60 right on known answers, at 17% of the cost of reading reviews one by one.

q.zh: 有据审核是什么？

zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

a.zh: 审广告的 Agent：说清违反哪一条、是哪几个字，广告主改完还能再审。对照英国监管机构的真实裁决，51/60 次判断一致，并指出违反哪条规定、哪几个字。
a.en: An ad-review agent that names the rule and the exact words, and reviews the advertiser's next version too. Matched the UK regulator's real rulings in 51/60 decisions, naming the rule and the exact words.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: AI 生图创作指南是什么？

zh: AI 生图创作指南：电商主图上的中文字
en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

a.zh: 测 AI 生图在电商主图上写中文卖点稳不稳，写成给商家的创作指南和上线前核对工具。Seedream 4.5 生成的主图，中文字全写对的 16/16；视频里只有 1/4。
a.en: It tests how reliably AI image models write Chinese selling points on product images, turned into a guide for merchants and a pre-listing checker. Seedream 4.5 got every Chinese character right in 16/16 product images; only 1/4 videos did.

label.zh: AI 生图创作指南：电商主图上的中文字
label.en: Text on Product: Chinese copy on AI product images

q.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测是什么？
q.en: What is Real-time voice agent evaluation?

zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测

a.zh: 测实时语音助手被打断、听到“嗯”、遇到噪声时，还能不能把事办对，再把有用的改进合在一起。背景有人说话时，助手从等 20.4 秒才开口，缩短到 4.56 秒。
a.en: It tests whether a real-time voice assistant still gets things right when interrupted, hearing "mm" or in noise, then combines the fixes that help. With someone talking in the background, the assistant's wait before replying fell from 20.4 s to 4.56 s.

label.zh: 实时语音 Agent 体验评测

q.zh: 有据标注流水线是什么？

a.zh: 把有据审核接成一条能灰度、能回滚的审核工作流，拿不准的交给人复核。让模型说“拿不准”后，判错又自动生效的从 17/332 降到 9/332。
a.en: It turns Grounded Review into a review workflow with canary release and rollback, sending unsure cases to people. Letting the model say it is unsure cut wrong decisions that went live from 17/332 to 9/332.

q.zh: 有据经营分析是什么？

a.zh: 在合成的经营数据上，让 Agent 自己查数找异动原因，周报里每个数字都对回查询结果。按题配对，Agent 比一次提示词多对 6 题、少对 0 题（p = 0.031）。
a.en: On synthetic business data, an agent queries for itself to find why a metric moved, and every number in the weekly review traces back to a query. Case by case, the agent beat the one prompt 6 to 0 (exact p = 0.031).

q.zh: 创作者 Skill 合集是什么？

a.zh: 给短视频创作者的三个 Skill：对字幕、拆分镜、挑热点，交出去之前先用脚本查一遍。装上 Skill 后，改好的字幕文件 20/20 完全正确，不装只有 2/20。
a.en: Three Skills for short-video creators, for subtitles, shot lists and trend topics, each checked by a script before it hands anything back. With the skill, corrected subtitle files were fully right 20/20; without it, 2/20.

q.zh: 审核模型实验是什么？

a.zh: 审视频广告时，模型要看文案、抽帧还是帧上的字，微调过的小模型够不够用。看 16 帧时违规全抓到（64/64），只给文案只抓到 25/64。
a.en: What a model needs to see to review a video ad, caption, frames or the text on them, and whether a small tuned model is enough. With 16 frames every violation was caught (64/64); with the caption only, 25/64.

q.zh: 模型裁判校准是什么？

a.zh: 测模型当裁判能信到什么程度，再定哪些检查交给脚本、哪些交给裁判、哪些留给人。和出题时定好的答案一致 702/711，植入的错误抓到 385/390。
a.en: It measures how far a model judge can be trusted, then sorts checks into those for a script, for the judge and for people. It agreed with the answers fixed at item-building time 702/711 and caught 385/390 planted errors.

q.zh: 标注 Agent 工具箱是什么？

a.zh: 一个换套规则和案例就能接新任务的标注 Agent，配上用对照实验和根因分析调它的工具。测试集 A 微平均 F1：广告 0.768 → 0.971，点评 0.715 → 0.824。
a.en: A labelling agent that takes on a new task with a new folder of rules and cases, plus the experiments and root-cause analysis to tune it. Test A micro F1: ads 0.768 → 0.971, reviews 0.715 → 0.824.

q.zh: Agent 评测台是什么？

a.zh: 评会调工具的 Agent 每一步做了什么，看得出失败从哪一步开始。装上 Skill 的创作流程成功 21/24，不装只有 8/24。
a.en: It scores what a tool-using agent does at every step, so you can see where a failure starts. With the skills loaded, the creator workflow succeeded 21/24; without them, 8/24.

q.zh: 怎么决定一个改动采用不采用？
q.en: How do you decide whether to adopt a change?

a.zh: 跑之前先写下预测和采用标准，结果出来照标准办。标注 Agent 的第二版在没用过的点评上 +0.018 [+0.005, +0.031]，过了标准，就采用。
a.en: I write the predictions and the adoption rule down before the run, then follow them. The labelling agent's second version gained +0.018 [+0.005, +0.031] on reviews it had never seen, cleared the bar, and was adopted.

label.zh: 标注 Agent 工具箱的迭代

q.zh: 报告里的数字是怎么来的？
q.en: Where do the numbers in the reports come from?

en: where do the numbers come from

a.zh: 数字由脚本直接从结果文件算出来，写进作品集前再用有据可查逐条对回出处。
a.en: The numbers come straight from the result files by script, and every one is matched back to its source with evidence-check before it goes into the portfolio.

q.zh: 题目和标准答案从哪来？
q.en: Where do the test items and answers come from?

a.zh: 答案在出题时就定好；再拿监管机构和法院对真实广告的结论、公开数据集里的专家评分做对照，Cairn 还用了学生自己提的真实问题。
a.en: Answers are fixed when the items are written; regulator and court decisions on real ads and the expert ratings in public datasets serve as outside checks, and Cairn also uses real questions students asked in their own words.

label.zh: 有据审核（广告审核 Agent）

q.zh: 和现成的工具比有什么不同？
q.en: How is this different from existing tools?

a.zh: 开工前先查现成的，能用就直接用，比如 promptfoo、agentevals、Inspect AI。我补的是它们没管的那块：有据可查专门盯数字和原话，看它们在不在给定的材料里。
a.en: I check what exists first and use it where it fits, like promptfoo, agentevals and Inspect AI. What I add is the part they leave out: evidence-check watches numbers and quotes and whether they are in the given material.

q.zh: 遇到过最难的问题是什么？

a.zh: 简历初筛里，核对引文那一步一开始会把对的“符合”也丢掉：70/424。我把这一步重做了两版。之后降到 0/422。
a.en: In resume screening, the quote-checking step at first threw away correct "met" verdicts too: 70/424. I rebuilt that step twice. After that it was 0/422.
